description: This file defines the NoteDao interface for database operations related to notes, including CRUD operations, queries for different note states (deleted, archived, non-remote), and sorting mechanisms within a note-taking app.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for performing database operations on notes, including insert, update, delete, and various query methods with sorting and filtering options.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a NoteEntity into the database, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates one or more NoteEntity records.

methods.name: updateLastModified
methods.description: Updates the modified date of a note identified by id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more NoteEntity records.

methods.name: permanentlyDeleteNotesInBin
methods.description: Permanently deletes notes marked as deleted.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID as a Flow.

methods.name: moveRemotelyDeletedNotesToBin
methods.description: Marks remote-deleted notes as deleted locally.

methods.name: rawGetQuery
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query returning a list of notes.

methods.name: getNonRemoteNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes not synchronized with remote, sorted by specified method.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Retrieves deleted notes, sorted by specified method.

methods.name: getArchived
methods.description: Retrieves archived notes, sorted by specified method.

methods.name: getNonDeleted
methods.description: Retrieves non-deleted notes, sorted by specified method.

methods.name: getNonDeletedOrArchived
methods.description: Retrieves notes that are neither deleted nor archived, sorted by specified method.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, sorted by specified method.

methods.name: getAllBlankTitleNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes with null or empty titles.

methods.name: getByNotebook
methods.description: Retrieves notes belonging to a specific notebook, sorted by specified method.

methods.name: getOrderByMethod
methods.description: Determines the SQL order and column based on the sort method.

methods.name: getNotesWithoutNotebook
methods.description: Retrieves notes not assigned to any notebook, sorted by specified method.
